s Regulate Day to Day

title: Systemic vs Local
Estrogen Therapy
cards.alt: Systemic estrogen treats hot flashes through the bloodstream; local vaginal therapy has lower risk as little is absorbed

cards.subject: HRT
cards.heading: Weighing the Risks and Modern Safety Standards
title: Modern
HRT
Safety Standards
cards.alt: HRT safety rests on timing before age 60, the lowest effective dose, and reviewing individual cancer and clot history

items.label: Timing
items.note: Before 60, or within 10 years of menopause

items.label: Dosage
items.note: The lowest effective dose, for as long as needed

items.label: Your history
items.note: Certain cancers, clots or liver disease change the plan

cards.subject: hormone therapy
cards.heading: Types of Hormone Therapy:
title: The Four Types of
Hormone Therapy
cards.alt: Four hormone therapy types: estrogen, combined estrogen and progesterone, testosterone, and thyroid replacement

items.label: Combined therapy
items.note: With progesterone, if the uterus is intact

items.label: Testosterone therapy
items.note: For men and women, low libido or energy

cards.subject: hormone therapy
cards.heading: Benefits of Hormone Therapy: How It Can Improve Your Quality of Life
title: What
Hormone Therapy
Can Improve
cards.alt: Hormone therapy can ease menopause symptoms, steady mood and clarity, protect bone density, and help skin and hair

cards.subject: hormone therapy
cards.heading: Risks and Considerations of Hormone Therapy
title: Hormone Therapy
Risks and Cautions
cards.alt: Hormone therapy risks include clots, stroke and some cancers; avoid it with a history of breast cancer or liver disease

cards.subject: hormone therapy
cards.heading: Alternatives to Hormone Therapy: What Are Your Options?
title: Alternatives to
Hormone Therapy
cards.alt: Hormone therapy alternatives: non-hormonal medications like SSRIs, bioidentical hormones, and herbal supplements

items.label: Non-hormonal medication
items.note: SSRIs and SNRIs for hot flashes and mood

items.label: Bioidentical hormones
items.note: Ask your doctor which are FDA-regulated

items.label: Herbal supplements
items.note: Black cohosh, soy, red clover, with guidance
